Meet the newest addition to
the Geláre family


Whether it’s our freshly baked waffles; premium range of ice cream or our small batch roasted barista-made coffee, we make sure we make everything fresh to order the old-fashioned way, while serving it up with our own signature style and flavours.

THE GELÁRE SECRET

The key to our signature ice cream range is that it is THICKER than Italian gelato, but it is also HEAVIER & CREAMIER than American ice cream.

Combined with cutting edge ice cream manufacturing technology, the proof is in the mouthful.
